description: This file contains functions for parsing HTTP security headers, specifically the Strict-Transport-Security header, including utility functions for parsing max-age values and handling header directives.

methods.name: MaxAgeToLimitedInt
methods.description: Converts a string representing seconds into a uint32_t, clipping to a limit if necessary, and handling overflow errors.

methods.name: ParseHSTSHeader
methods.description: Parses the Strict-Transport-Security header string to extract max-age and includeSubdomains directives.
